title: AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon form a JV that aims to expand US satellite coverage and eliminate dead zones, appointing industry veteran Paul Roth as interim CEO (David Shepardson/Reuters)
summary: David Shepardson / Reuters: AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon form a JV that aims to expand US satellite coverage and eliminate dead zones, appointing industry veteran Paul Roth as interim CEO — AT&T (T.N), T-Mobile (TMUS.O) and Verizon (VZ.N) have appointed wireless industry veteran Paul Roth as interim chief executive …
